title: Babylonian Chronology 626 B.C.–A.D. 45 (SAOC 24)

verification_log.method: Downloaded and read the OCR text of the 1942 edition

p. 11: Nabonidus Chronicle iii 14–18: Sippar fell VII/14/17 = 11 Oct 539, Babylon fell VII/16/17 = 13 Oct, Cyrus entered VIII/3 = 29 Oct; last Nabonidus tablet from Uruk dated the day after the fall (VII/17/17 = 14 Oct); Nabonidus's first texts 25 May 556, sole ruler by end of June 556; Neriglissar's last text 12 Apr 556; Cyrus's last texts Aug 530 (12 Aug), Cambyses's first 31 Aug 530; year tables: Cyrus year 1 Nisan 1 = 24 Mar 538

access_notes: Read through the Internet Archive OCR text of the Oriental Institute PDF; OCR has digit errors (e.g. "589" for 539) checked against context. The 1956 revised edition was not consulted.
